hazardStatements: May cause allergy or asthma symptoms — confirm SDS
hazards.notes: β-lactam sensitizer — dedicated manufacturing suites common.

overview: Penicillin G is produced by aerobic fermentation of Penicillium strains, followed by extraction and crystallization of salt forms. It is both a clinical API family member and the industrial gateway to 6-APA for semi-synthetic penicillins such as amoxicillin.
manufacturingSummary: Seed train → production fermentation → broth harvest → solvent extraction / purification → salt crystallization → drying. Cross-contamination control for β-lactams is a facility-level design driver.

environmentBaseline.containment: β-lactam dedicated HVAC cascades / pressure regimes
environmentBaseline.notes: Biosafety and allergen control dominate plant design

routes.name: Aerobic fermentation + extraction (industrial)
routes.summary: Fed-batch fermentation producing penicillin G, then multi-step recovery to pharmaceutical salt.

steps.title: Seed train & production fermentation
steps.description: Expand inoculum through seed stages into production fermenter. Control DO, pH, temperature, and feed. Harvest at titer target.
steps.scaleNotes: Oxygen transfer and heat removal dominate large fermenters.

steps.title: Harvest, extraction, purification
steps.description: Clarify broth; extract penicillin into organic phase under controlled pH; back-extract and purify.

environment.atexZone: Solvent areas classified per site standards

steps.title: Salt crystallization & drying
steps.description: Crystallize potassium, procaine, or benzathine salt per product; wash and dry under controlled conditions.

scaleUp.pilotToCommercial: Fermenter geometry and extraction train capacity
scaleUp.safetyScaleUp: β-lactam suite design and decontamination validation

sourceRefs.note: Educational fermentation outline — not a plant design package

routes.name: Downstream: cleavage to 6-APA (linked intermediate train)
routes.summary: Enzymatic side-chain cleavage of penicillin G to 6-APA for semi-synthetic coupling (e.g. amoxicillin).
disadvantages: Additional unit ops and enzyme handling

steps.title: Enzymatic deacylation
steps.description: Cleave phenylacetyl side chain with penicillin acylase under controlled pH; isolate 6-APA.

sourceRefs.note: Cross-link to amoxicillin Tier-A example for full semi-synthetic story
